metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Pullovers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film pullovers for your team. Vibrant, durable prints on quality fleece. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Direct to film printing allows for full-color, highly detailed artwork on pullovers without the stiffness of traditional screen printing. This method is ideal for complex logos, gradients, or photographic images on fleece jackets, hoodies, and crewnecks. DTF transfers adhere well to polyester and cotton blends, making them a versatile choice for corporate apparel, safety incentives, or promotional giveaways. The prints remain flexible and crack-resistant through repeated washes.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film pullovers featuring a full-color logo on a black fleece hoodie, showing vibrant detail and soft hand feel.
